items.title: Skip sending request bodies to Routing Middleware
items.snippet: You can now skip sending client request bodies to Routing Middleware with skipMiddlewareRequestBody . This reduces incoming Fast Origin Transfer usage for middleware invocations and can improve time to first byte, especially for requests with large bodies. Enable this option only if your Routing Middleware doesn’t read request bodies. Vercel Fu
